comparison.objective: Both tasks set an articulated mechanism to a target angle, lock it without losing the setting, withdraw, and verify hands-off retention.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate counterholds an adjustment screw while tightening its jam nut; the inspection-arm task supports a loaded arm at +15° while the other hand tightens an indexed clamp.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires 90° retained through three cycles; the inspection arm must retain +15° for two seconds after locking and withdrawal, though its body omits detailed tolerances and partial-score thresholds.
comparison.reason: Despite different hardware, both centrally test bimanual preservation of a target angle while the other hand tightens its lock, followed by released retention.
